crossRefs.note: Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable in your sight, Yahweh, my rock, and my redeemer.
“How long will you speak these things? Shall the words of your mouth be a mighty wind?
“Who is this who darkens counsel by words without knowledge?
You asked, ‘Who is this who hides counsel without knowledge?’ therefore I have uttered that which I didn’t understand…
Therefore I abhor myself, and repent in dust and ashes.”
It will happen at that time, that I will search Jerusalem with lamps, and I will punish the men who are settled on…
“Your words have been stout against me,” says Yahweh. “Yet you say, ‘What have we spoken against you?’
The good man out of his good treasure brings out good things, and the evil man out of his evil treasure brings out evil…
If anyone among you thinks himself to be religious while he doesn’t bridle his tongue, but deceives his heart, this…
For we all stumble in many things. Anyone who doesn’t stumble in word is a perfect person, able to bridle the whole…
“You give your mouth to evil. Your tongue frames deceit.
because they have done foolish things in Israel, and have committed adultery with their neighbors’ wives, and have…
For the word of God is living and active, and sharper than any two-edged sword, piercing even to the dividing of soul…

translations.web: For there is not a word on my tongue, but, behold, Yahweh, you know it altogether.
translations.bsb: Even before a word is on my tongue, You know all about it, O LORD.
translations.kjv: For there is not a word in my tongue, but, lo, O LORD, thou knowest
translations.asv: For there is not a word in my tongue, But, lo, O Jehovah, thou knowest it altogether.
